name: SJSU Summer Session (Open University) for High School Students
city: San Jose, CA (online, hybrid and in person)
what_you_do: High school students can take SJSU summer college courses for credit through Open University without being admitted. More than 500 courses.
who_can_apply: High school students can register for summer classes through Open University without being admitted to SJSU.
pay_detail: Price not on the page; ask Summer Session (see SJSU Fees, Payment and Refund)
duration: 5 or 10 week sessions (2026: June 1 to Aug 7)
deadline_text: Summer 2026: Open University registration began April 15 and closed July 13. 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Register as an Open University student using the first-time or returning student steps on the SJSU Summer registration page. Questions: professionaled@sjsu.edu or 408-924-2670.
notes: You pay college tuition. The page does not state age, grade or approval rules for high schoolers or the cost, so ask Summer Session. For fall and spring the page points to the Dual Enrollment Program (dualenrollment@sjsu.edu).
